verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no feature for exporting a user's account data (workflows, runs, credentials, artifacts) in open formats for migration. Self-hosting, the open-source codebase, the REST/OpenAPI surface, and JSON-schema extraction of website data are adjacent capabilities. None is a documented export-and-leave path, so none earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
